# Discussions guide

Simple map. Use the right place so Mitun and the community can help fast.

## Pick one

| You want… | Go here |
|-----------|---------|
| How do I install / use ACC? | [**Q&A**](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/discussions/new?category=q-a) |
| Soft idea or suggestion | [**Ideas**](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/discussions/new?category=ideas) |
| Show a project you built | [**Show and tell**](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/discussions/new?category=show-and-tell) |
| Casual chat / intro | [**General**](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/discussions/new?category=general) |
| Something is broken | [**Bug issue**](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| Install / `$setup` failed | [**Install issue**](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/issues/new?template=install_problem.yml) |
| Concrete feature for the backlog | [**Feature issue**](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| Full issues map | [**ISSUES.md**](ISSUES.md) |
| Live chat | [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/qgS29y7TqP) |
| Security problem | [**Private advisory**](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/security/advisories/new) only |

## Start here

1. [Start here — install in 3 steps](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/discussions/5)  
2. [FAQ — install, $setup, bug vs question](https://github.com/mitunmanav/anyone-can-code/discussions/9)

**Maintainer:** pin #5 and #9 in the GitHub Discussions UI (API cannot pin). Order: Q&A → Ideas → Show and tell → General.

## Tips (non-technical OK)

1. One topic per discussion.  
2. Plain English is fine.  
3. Say: what you wanted · what you did · what happened.  
4. Remove tokens, passwords, and private paths.  
5. Search existing discussions before opening a new one.

## Categories (quick)

| Category | For |
|----------|-----|
| Q&A | Questions; answers can be marked correct |
| Ideas | Feature thoughts before they become Issues |
| Show and tell | Projects built with ACC |
| General | Everything else that is still about ACC |
| Announcements | Maintainer updates only |
| Polls | Community votes |

## Issues vs Discussions

- **Discussions** = questions, ideas, showcases, conversation.  
- **Issues** = bugs and tracked work items.  
- **AI maintainer briefs** run on Issues/PRs (not Discussions).  

More support paths: [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md)
